verdict.rationale: Wise Business is a business-banking and payments product, so in-product AI-generated insights are a fair capability to ask about. The evidence pack shows no AI insights, suggestions or analytics features. It covers only payments, accounts, cards, statements, webhooks and an llms.txt docs file, which serves AI consumers of the documentation rather than in-product insights.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
